title: Sri Lanka Retreat with Excursion to Galle
highlights: Wander around Kandy Lake and embrace the city's historical significance amidst serene surroundings
Indulge in relaxation and adventure at Bentota's sun-kissed beaches and engage in water sports
Venture on a captivating day-trip to Galle, a UNESCO World Heritage site boasting Dutch colonial architecture
Explore the vibrant Colombo Fort area, marvel at the architectural wonder of the Lotus Tower, and discover the dynamic energy of the city's bustling markets and diverse culinary scene
Witness the cultural diversity of Sri Lanka, from the spiritual traditions of Kandy to the coastal relaxation in Bentota, and the historical richness of Galle
overview:
About the Tour:
Go on a captivating journey through the multifaceted landscapes and cultural wonders of Sri Lanka. Kandy, a city steeped in spirituality and history. Explore the revered Temple of the Tooth Relic, wander along the tranquil shores of Kandy Lake, and lose yourself in the vibrant energy of local markets. From Kandy, venture to Bentota, a coastal paradise where golden beaches meet the azure waters of the Indian Ocean. Bask in the sun's warmth, partake in thrilling water sports, and glide through Bentota River's mangrove forests.
The highlight of your journey leads you to Galle, a UNESCO World Heritage site exuding the charm of its well-preserved Dutch colonial architecture. Wander through cobblestone streets adorned with a fusion of European and South Asian influences. Explore the iconic Galle Lighthouse, soak in the historical charm of the fort, and capture the vibrant coastal atmosphere. Concluding your odyssey in the cosmopolitan capital, Colombo, delve into the historic Fort area, marvel at the modern architectural elegance of the Lotus Tower, and experience the dynamic spirit of the World Trade Center. Stroll through bustling shopping streets, savor local flavors, and immerse yourself in the rich cultural tapestry that defines Colombo, encapsulating the diverse allure of Sri Lanka in a memorable journey.
inclusions: Transfer from Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport to Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
1 night stay in Kandy with breakfast
2 nights stay in Bentota with breakfast
1 night stay in Colombo with breakfast
Transfer from Deluxe Hotel to Bandaranaike International Colombo Airport
exclusions: Meals not mentioned in the itinerary or inclusions
know_before_you_go: ID proof is mandatory for each individual guest at the time of arrival.
All foreign nationals must share their passport and visa details at the time of arrival.
All international and domestic airfare, visa fees, airport tax, or any kind of insurance cover is not a part of the package.
Any personal expenses or items of personal nature will not be included in the package.
Any breakage or damage of any items in the resort will be charged at actuals.
The hotels are subject to their availability. In case they are not available, the travelers will be accommodated in a property of similar standard.
Avoid using plastic bags and maintain the ecological balance of the destinations. Travelers littering may be fined.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Colombo to Kandy | Visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
days.desc: Upon your arrival, the representative will pick you up from Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your hotel in Kandy. On the way, visit the Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and the Tooth Relic Temple. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. In the evening, visit Kandy Lake and enjoy a Kandyan Dance performance. After exploring, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the Bandaranaike International Airport and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Kandy.
In the evening, the representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Kandy Lake.
Afterwards, get transferred to witness the Kandyan Dance performance
After a fun-filled day, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Kandy.

items.title: Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage
items.desc:
Visit Pinnawala Elephant Orphanage and enjoy elephants enjoying their daily bath in the Maha Oya River. 
Engage in the feeding sessions and feed the elephants fruits and other specially prepared elephant-friendly food.

items.title: Tooth Relic Temple
items.desc:
Explore the sacred Temple of the Tooth Relic (Sri Dalada Maligawa), home to the revered relic of the Buddha's tooth. 
Marvel at the intricate architecture and experience the spiritual ambiance of one of Sri Lanka's most important religious sites.

items.title: The Temple of the Sacred Tooth Relic
Kandy Lake | Kandyan Dance Performance
items.desc:
Take leisurely strolls along the beautifully landscaped pathways surrounding Kandy Lake. 
Attend a Kandyan Dance performance and immerse yourself in the rich cultural heritage of Sri Lanka. 
Witness awe-inspiring feats such as fire walking and acrobatics during the Kandyan Dance performance.

days.title: Kandy to Bentota | Visit the Turtle Hatchery
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from your hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Bentota. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Bentota. Visit Madu River where you can enjoy a scenic boat ride. Then, enjoy a relaxing pedicure at the fish pedicure center. Continue to Turtle Hatchery and see adorable turtles. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Bentota.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Bentota.
Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Bentota.

items.title: Bentota Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Enjoy a stroll along the shores of the Madu River and take in the scenic views of the surroundings.
Immerse your feet in a unique and rejuvenating fish spa experience at the Fish Pedicure Center.
Explore the Turtle Hatchery and get to know about the conservation efforts aimed at protecting endangered sea turtles.

days.title: Excursion to Galle | Visit the Dutch Fort
days.desc: After breakfast, the representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you on an excursion to Galle. Upon arrival in Galle, visit the Galle Fort and wander through the narrow cobblestone streets of the fort. You can also visit the National Maritime Museum, the iconic Clock Tower, the famous lighthouse and the Dutch Reformed Church. Post excursion, get transferred back to your hotel in Bentota for an overnight stay.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you on an excursion to Galle for sightseeing.
After excursion, get transferred back to your hotel in Bentota for an overnight stay.

items.title: Excursion to Galle
items.desc:
Admire the well-preserved Dutch colonial architecture and explore charming boutiques, art galleries, and cafes housed within the Galle Fort's walls.
Explore the various exhibits at the National Maritime Museum showcasing artifacts, ship models, and maritime memorabilia and get to know about the island's seafaring past.
Take in the panoramic views of the surrounding ocean and Galle Fort from the Galle Lighthouse.
Visit the Dutch Reformed Church and admire the intricate Dutch colonial architecture, tall windows, and serene interior that reflect the church's rich history.

days.title: Bentota To Colombo | The Commercial Capital of Sri Lanka
days.desc: After breakfast, check out from the hotel and get transferred to your hotel in Colombo. Upon arrival in Colombo, check in to your hotel and get ready for a sightseeing tour of Colombo. Visit the Colombo Fort and wander through its streets. Then, explore the bustling markets of Pettah. Continue to the iconic Lotus Tower. Then, head to the Lover's Island. Head to the World Trade Building. After sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel for an overnight stay in Colombo.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc:
The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to your pre-booked hotel in Colombo.
After check-in, the representative will take you on a sightseeing tour of Colombo.
Post sightseeing, get transferred back to your hotel in Colombo for an overnight stay.

items.title: Colombo Sightseeing Tour
items.desc:
Explore colonial-era buildings, visit the Old Dutch Hospital transformed into a shopping and dining precinct at the Colombo Fort.
Explore local shops, spice markets, and street vendors offering everything from textiles to fresh produce at the Pettah Market.
Marvel at the Lotus Tower, an iconic modern landmark dominating Colombo's skyline and take in the panoramic views of the city from its observation decks.
Enjoy a leisurely stroll along the shore at Lover's Island and take in the picturesque views of the surroundings.
Visit the World Trade Center, a bustling commercial hub symbolizing Colombo's economic prowess.

days.title: Departure | Take a Bag Full of Memories
days.desc: After breakfast, pack your bags and check out from the hotel. The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Bandaranaike International Airport, where your trip will come to an end.

items.title: Transfer in Sedan
items.desc: The representative will pick you up from the hotel and take you to Bandaranaike International Airport for your flight back home.
